lines.text: Behind the mansion, along the path leading to the elevator,
a veritable mountain of garbage is piled up.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: It reeks.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: I can't believe they put a trash dump right behind the mansion.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: How do they stand being so close to this stench?
Hmm...
Guess they just get used to it.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: What?
The residents here pick through heaps of trash dumped from the Ark, searching for anything they can salvage.
They make a living selling what they find.
You just have to learn to live with the smell if you want to survive out in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Ahh... let me get this straight.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: They make ends meet by selling trash dumped from the Ark.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: And putting up with smells like this,

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: is the reality people face in this world?
... Yes.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Reality is unforgiving no matter where you go.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Quiry?
Quiry fidgets with her rocket launcher in silence.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Hey, Quiry...?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Y-yes?

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: A penny for your thoughts?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I was just thinking...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I-is it really okay?
Is what okay?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I-I can't help but think that someone other than me should have tagged along.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Someone with more field experience, like Agent Winters from B.S.T.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Or someone who's more suited for combat.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: You were blasting things left and right with that rocket launcher,

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: and now you second-guess yourself?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Before this, most of what I'd done had been administrative work.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Except under special circumstances, Poli or Miranda typically handle field operations...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Saving all of humanity...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Such a monumental task is better left to someone else, not me...

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Come on. None of that stuff matters.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: I was just an ordinary college student.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: But I survived Raccoon City, and now I'm surviving just fine here too.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: It's what's in here that counts. Our hearts.
Claire lightly taps her chest with her fist.
Watching Claire, Quiry mutters quietly.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: That's what counts...?

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: You came all the way to this dangerous place because you wanted to save your friend.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: And not only did you rescue Poli, you did it with style.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: That means you can save Deipara, too.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Hell, you can even save all of humanity.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: You've got what it takes.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Y-you think so?

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: And there's more good news.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: What's that...?

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: You're not alone, because you've got me.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: So...? That's comforting, right?
A faint smile crosses Quiry's face at Claire's playful words.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Yeah, I feel really reassured.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: So it's what's inside that counts... What's inside...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Whew...
Quiry grips the launcher tightly with what seemed like newfound resolve.
Shall we keep moving?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Yes!
I spot the elevator K told us about in the distance.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Here too, huh.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: We can't catch a break, can we?
In front of the elevator stood more of the same creatures we've been fighting all this time.
*Clack*
Quiry lifts her loaded launcher.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I-I'll take the lead!
After the battle. In front of the elevator.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Hah... hahahah...
Elseria Nine lies on the ground in a heap.
Her abdomen is torn open.
It looks like one of those monsters got to her.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Life falls into oblivion... into turmoil.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Cruel distortion... of all things sacred.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Cold, metallic judges... descend.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Do not resist...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: The end is... nigh.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Guide... these foolish mortals...
... Elseria Nine.
The plan you and the Torch of Salvation put together is doomed to fail.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: ... Fail?
That's right.
Doing this won't save anyone.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Hah... hahahah...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Heathens like you wouldn't understand...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Just you wait. On the day of reckoning, we'll see who is saved.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Death... is the path to salvation.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Death is the path that leads to salvation...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Death is...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: ... Salvation.
While tending to the delirious cult leader's wounds, Quiry shakes her head.
Suddenly, the cult leader starts speaking to someone other than those of us present.
Her eyes lose focus and their light gradually dims.

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: You're waiting for me, aren't you?

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: I told you... Deipara and I would come...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: We'd return... to the happy days we once had...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: And receive salvation...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: ... With Deipara?

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Deipara...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: Deipara's... in the elevator...

lines.speaker: elserianine
lines.text: What... what have I done...?
The elevator?
Inside the elevator, countless homemade explosives cover the floor.
*Beep beep beep*
A countdown display in the center ticks down one second at a time like a time bomb.
In addition to the bombs...
I spot Deipara lying on the floor.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Claire, don't! It's too dangerous!
Quiry holds back Claire, who was about to rush into the array of bombs.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: But—!
Countless bombs.
The timer slowly ticking down.
And Deipara, lying in the middle of it all.
Claire's eyes dart back and forth before she shuts them.
Then, seemingly recalling someone, she utters a name.
The young girl she met in her own world...

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: ... Sherry.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: I'm sorry, Quiry.
Claire shakes off Quiry.
Ignoring the bombs,
Claire rushes straight toward Deipara.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Are you okay?
Deipara remains limp, and doesn't respond.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: She's still breathing...
Distinct needle marks can be seen on Deipara's shoulder.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: No...
Claire, fall back now.
She might be infected by the virus...

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: I don't care!

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: I can't leave her like this.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: And even if she is infected,

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: as long as there's a vaccine,

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: we'll be able to treat her somehow...

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: I don't know if a vaccine exists in this world...

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: But it's better than giving up on her without doing anything...

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: ... It's always better to put up a fight.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: Is this what you're looking for?
Ada holds a syringe filled with a red liquid.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: I told you I wouldn't let the NEO-Virus

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: leave this mansion, right?

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: You'd better use it quickly.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: And I do mean quickly.
*Beep beep beep*

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: We should probably do something about these explosives while we're at it.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Oh... I-I'll do it!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I've memorized all the procedures for handling explosives circulated in the Ark!

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: All right. Once they're taken care of...

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: I think we've done everything we can here.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: Wouldn't you agree?
... Yeah. Looks like it.

lines.speaker: deipara
lines.text: *Cough cough*

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Deipara, can you hear me?!

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: Don't move. I'm going to give you something that'll help you.

lines.speaker: ce007_03
lines.text: It's going to sting a little.
Looks like we still have a few loose ends to tie up.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: Loose ends such as...

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: The location where the virus' components are found.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: If we want to put an end to all this, we'll need to take care of that too.
Exactly.
Once things settle down here, we'll take care of it.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: Well then, since our deal has concluded...

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: Guess this is where I make my exit.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: Oh, right. That woman, Elseria Nine, was it?

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: She was holding onto something important.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: I'd suggest you look into it.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: You might find something...interesting.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: Well then...

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: I leave it to you.

lines.speaker: ce007_01
lines.text: Be sure you make the right decisions.
Ada?
By the time I turned around, Ada was already gone.
The inside of the elevator is in complete disarray.
*Beep beep beep*
Elseria Nine's vision fades, and memories of the past flash before her eyes.
*Beep beep beep*
Gathering at the dinner table every evening to talk about our day.
All of us sprawled out, watching TV together in comfort.
The quiet little conversations we'd have before falling asleep.
*Beep beep beep*
Memories of those happier days begin to fade,
and are replaced by new ones.
*Beep beep beep*
Her husband's hospital room,
where she stood witnessing his final moments.
The eyes of Elseria Nine and those of her husband lock.
*Beeeeeeep*
